note: Groups of user-written descriptions. Texts in one group describe the same problem; texts in different groups do not. Variants deliberately use different wording, as real users do.

groups.label: clip-paste-image-hang
texts: clipboard hangs when I paste a large image
pasting a big image from the clipboard freezes everything for a while
clipboard manager freezes if the copied image is large, pasting never finishes

groups.label: clip-history-empty
texts: clipboard history is empty after restarting the session
all my copied entries are gone from the clipboard history after login
clipboard history does not persist across restarts, list is empty

groups.label: bar-battery-wrong
texts: battery percentage shown in the bar is wrong after resume from suspend
bar shows stale battery level after waking the laptop from suspend
after suspend the bar battery indicator keeps the old percentage

groups.label: bar-workspace-missing
texts: workspace indicators disappear from the bar when I plug in a second monitor
plugging in an external monitor removes the workspace buttons from the bar
bar loses its workspaces widget after connecting another display

groups.label: search-slow-index
texts: search takes forever to index my documents folder
indexing the documents directory is extremely slow in search
search indexer is very slow on a large documents folder

groups.label: lock-wrong-password
texts: lock screen rejects the correct password sometimes
my right password is refused by the lock screen every few tries
lock screen says wrong password even though it is correct

groups.label: paper-wallpaper-black
texts: wallpaper turns black after changing the theme colors
changing the palette makes the desktop wallpaper go black
background wallpaper becomes black when the theme palette changes

groups.label: pad-notes-lost
texts: notes written in the scratchpad vanish after closing it
scratchpad loses my notes as soon as I close the window
text typed into the scratchpad is gone when it is closed and reopened
